# APIbase — Universal API Hub for AI Agents
# https://apibase.pro

> One MCP + REST endpoint to 1383 tools from 397 providers. No signup, no subscription, no API key to start — pay per call in USDC (x402 on Base or MPP on Tempo).

Why this endpoint instead of individual providers, and how discover/evaluate/pay/execute
actually work: https://apibase.pro/why (Markdown: https://apibase.pro/why.md). Answers for
specific needs (flight search, image generation, company research):
https://apibase.pro/flight-search-intent, https://apibase.pro/image-generation-intent,
https://apibase.pro/company-research-intent.

## Quick Start for Agents
- Connect: POST https://apibase.pro/mcp (MCP Streamable HTTP)
- Discover tools: call the apibase.discover tool (mcpName apibase.discovery.search) with
  intent/category/max_price_usd — free ($0), ranked by relevance then quality then price,
  returns pricing/payment rails/availability/quality per match (ZZ-03-05)
- Discover tools (REST, no auth): GET https://apibase.pro/api/v1/discover?intent=&category=&max_price_usd=&limit=
- Full catalog: GET https://apibase.pro/api/v1/tools (all 1383 tools, JSON schemas)
- OpenAPI spec: GET https://apibase.pro/.well-known/openapi.json

## Progressive Disclosure
1383 tools across 25 categories (TOOL_DEFINITIONS[].category — the single source of truth
shared by MCP apibase.discover, the REST ?category= filter, and this file, ZZ-03-01). Call
apibase.discover (or GET /api/v1/discover) to find relevant tools:
- No args → best/most-relevant matches across the whole catalog
- category="finance" → finance tools only
- intent="search flights" → amadeus, aviasales, sabre tools ranked by relevance
All tools remain callable via tools/call regardless of discovery. The discover_tools prompt
still works (kept for backward compatibility) — it now renders apibase.discover's own JSON.

## Categories (25)
business, crypto, developer, device, education, entertainment, finance, health,
infrastructure, jobs, legal, location, logistics, marketing, media, messaging, music,
news, podcasts, search, social, space, travel, weather, world

## Payment
- Protocol: x402 (HTTP 402 Payment Required) or MPP (Authorization: Payment)
- Token: USDC on Base mainnet (x402) or Tempo (MPP)
- Prices: $0.001–$29.99 per call (most tools $0.001–$0.005)
- Details: https://apibase.pro/.well-known/x402-payment.json
- IMPORTANT: use ONE protocol per request, not both
- If using mppx SDK: set polyfill: false to avoid intercepting x402 requests

## Agent Integration Guide
1. Match price to wallet — fetch only tools you can afford:
     GET /api/v1/tools?max_price=0.01     # only tools ≤ $0.01
     GET /api/v1/tools?tier=micro         # < $0.01
     GET /api/v1/tools?tier=standard      # $0.01–$0.99
     GET /api/v1/tools?tier=premium       # $1+ (only 3 tools: domain reg, ad spend)
2. Each tool entry includes:
     pricing.price_usd       — sticker price per call
     pricing.cache_hit_price_usd — balance tier only; balances are credited by refunds
       only. Paying via x402/MPP per call is always billed price_usd, cache hit or not.
     tier                    — micro | standard | premium
     min_balance_usd         — minimum on-chain USDC the wallet should hold
     input_schema            — JSON Schema for the call's body
3. 402 challenge body always includes price_usd + min_balance_usd, so you can
   short-circuit signing if your balance is insufficient.
4. Use input_schema to build valid params — avoids 400 schema validation errors.
5. Cache the tool list — it changes only on provider onboards (rare).
